g.text: GDHUB-88 — from the checkpoint landing to a purchase (never "start": you head for a checkpoint)

text.tspan: Checkpoint landing /checkpoint
CTA → /checkpoint/new
/signin?callbackUrl=/checkpoint/new
(has an account)
/registration?intent=checkpoint
intent kept in the pre-registration cookie (like `for`)
after sign-up → /checkpoint/new, not onboarding
(proxy lets /checkpoint/new through while onboardingDone is false)
Hub /checkpoint/new — 'Head for your first checkpoint'
facts: 28 days · one goal · expert or AI curator · from 19 USD
items unlock strictly in order
1 Tell us about yourself (12.1)
name, avatar, speciality → the existing profile/speciality APIs
Interest = author, onboardingDone = true
'Save and go back'
2 Tell us about your project (12.2)
Project Select (cover · name · stage) or New project modal
What's done so far: 1–5 items, optional evidence
'Save and go back'
New project modal (12.2d)
POST /api/user/project { name, description (pitch), genre, stage, agree, understandsNotAi }
→ project + team + Founder + devlog (as today)
→ ProjectWorkflow from the 'default' WorkflowSchema:
stages before the chosen one finished, currentStep = chosen (never Introduction)
the same for the hub's Create project
Saving item 2 → PUT /api/checkpoint/entry/project { projectId, items[≤5] }
1. the project's draft checkpoint: existing one or createDraftCheckpoint
(a project on Introduction is moved to Ideation)
2. items = CheckpointItem kind Input { text, artifactId? }, replaced as a set
3. evidence = project artifacts (uploaded / linked via the evidence slot)
First open for a project with a closed checkpoint:
prefill items from it — delivered outcomes first (readable artifact, not cut),
then its inputs; at most 5; artifacts carried
3 Your checkpoint — 'Set the goal →'
→ /user/project/[slug]/workflow/cp/new (the draft)

g.text: Wizard in the same light shell: 1 Goal → 2 Curator → 3 Payment → Stripe

text.tspan: AI (Active): 'You're on your way' · Day 1 of 28
Go to the workflow · receipt inline
Pro (AwaitingCurator): 'Payment reserved — charged when the curator accepts'
we email when they answer · Go to the workflow · receipt inline
Replace the curator / Cancel and refund (quiet)
Fixes
- AI no longer says 'waiting for the curator'
- reload of ?step=ready on an Active checkpoint → the workflow, not 'no draft'
- settling polls invalidate the list key too
GET /api/checkpoint/entry → { aboutDone, projects[{id, slug, name, cover, stage, running}],
draft: {projectId, itemsCount} | null } — one call drives the hub
